title: Urinary bisphenol A concentrations in adults from Shanghai, China: a cross-sectional study
abstract: A cross-sectional biomonitoring survey of 1200 adults from the general population of Shanghai. Urinary bisphenol A was measured by isotope dilution liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry.
authors: Zhang W; Li M; Chen H

title: Urinary bisphenol A exposure and reproductive outcomes in Chinese pregnant women: a cohort study
abstract: A prospective cohort of 800 pregnant women recruited in Hangzhou. Urinary bisphenol A concentrations were determined in each trimester and related to reproductive outcomes.

title: Urinary bisphenol A levels among children in Guangdong, China: a school-based survey
abstract: A school-based survey measuring urinary bisphenol A in 640 children aged 6 to 12 years from Guangdong. Geometric mean concentrations are reported by sex and age group.

title: Urinary bisphenol A concentrations and type 2 diabetes in Chinese adults: a longitudinal study
abstract: A longitudinal study of 980 Chinese adults examining the association between urinary bisphenol A and incident type 2 diabetes over four years of follow-up.

title: Urinary bisphenol A in pregnant women from Zhejiang, China: exposure levels and determinants
abstract: Cross-sectional analysis of urinary bisphenol A in 500 pregnant women from Zhejiang, with determinants including diet and personal care product use.

title: Urinary bisphenol A and thyroid hormone levels in Chinese adults: a repeated-measures study
abstract: Repeated urinary bisphenol A measurements in 430 adults from Tianjin with concurrent thyroid hormone assessment. Sample collection was performed in 2019.

title: Urinary concentrations of bisphenol A among pregnant women in Beijing, China
abstract: Biomonitoring of 700 pregnant women in Beijing. Urinary bisphenol A geometric mean concentrations are reported overall and by trimester.

title: Urinary bisphenol A levels in preschool children from rural Sichuan, China: seasonal variation
abstract: Seasonal assessment of bisphenol A exposure among 300 preschool children in rural Sichuan. Detection frequencies and demographic characteristics are described.

title: Bisphenol A and endocrine disruption: a systematic review of human studies
abstract: A systematic review synthesizing human evidence on bisphenol A and endocrine outcomes, following PRISMA guidance.

title: Bisphenol A exposure assessment in human populations: a meta-analysis of urinary concentrations
abstract: A meta-analysis pooling urinary bisphenol A concentrations reported in human biomonitoring studies worldwide.

title: Bisphenol A research in China: a narrative review of environmental and human studies
abstract: A narrative review summarizing two decades of bisphenol A research in China across environmental and human disciplines.

title: Effects of bisphenol A on hepatic gene expression in Sprague-Dawley rats
abstract: Male Sprague-Dawley rats were exposed to bisphenol A by oral gavage for 28 days and hepatic gene expression was profiled.

title: Developmental exposure to bisphenol A alters social behavior in mice
abstract: Mice exposed developmentally to bisphenol A showed altered social interaction in adulthood. Behavioral domains and doses are described.

title: Reproductive toxicity of bisphenol A in male rats: a dose-response study
abstract: A dose-response study of bisphenol A administration in male rats with reproductive organ histopathology and sperm analysis.

title: Effects of bisphenol A on HepG2 cell line viability and oxidative stress responses
abstract: HepG2 cells were exposed to bisphenol A at environmental and supraphysiological concentrations; viability and oxidative stress markers were assessed.
keywords: bisphenol A; cell line; oxidative stress

title: Bisphenol A induces mitochondrial dysfunction in vitro in HEK293 cells
abstract: An in vitro characterization of bisphenol A effects on mitochondrial membrane potential in HEK293 cells.

title: Bisphenol A in thermal paper receipts: migration and dermal exposure assessment
abstract: Migration of bisphenol A from thermal paper receipts was quantified and dermal uptake was estimated with a hand-wipe technique. No human biological samples were collected.

title: Dietary determinants of bisphenol A intake among Chinese households: a questionnaire-based survey
abstract: A questionnaire-based survey of dietary habits in 900 Chinese households used to model intake of bisphenol A from canned food and packaged beverages. No biomarkers were measured.

title: Urinary bisphenol A concentrations in adults from Shanghai, China: a cross-sectional biomonitoring study
abstract: A biomonitoring survey of 1200 adults from the general population of Shanghai. Urinary bisphenol A was measured by isotope dilution liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry with isotopically labelled standards.
authors: Zhang W; Li M; Chen H
